protocol: Rule-based rewrite of an article title; gold is still every indexed chunk of that same article. Same-article title recovery, not claim verification, and not a lexical stress test.
note: The rewrite did not cut lexical overlap enough to be a stress test. Mean token Jaccard is 0.806 and content-word retention is 0.942. TF-IDF article Hit@1 rose from 0.6533 to 0.6767. Do not read this table as a robustness result.
